name: -fid
definition: cleft; branched.

name: -foliate
definition: number of leaves, e.g. bifoliate = with 2 leaves.

name: -foliolate
definition: number of leaflets in compound leaf, e.g. bifoliolate = with 2 leaflets.

name: -locular
definition: cavities; e.g. 2-locular, with 2 cavities.

name: -merous
definition: the number of parts per floral whorl, e.g. 3-merous in Liliaceae flowers.

name: -partite
definition: divided, into segments, e.g. 3-partite style.

name: -ploid
definition: multiple of a single basic set of chromosomes in the nucleus; e.g. haploid = 1 set, diploid = 2 sets; see also polyploid.

name: abaxial
definition: the side away from the axis; e.g. the under-surface of an erect leaf.

name: abortive
definition: not developed normally; not fully developed.

name: abscission
definition: (adjective abscissile) the normal shedding from a plant of an organ that is mature or aged, e.g. a ripe fruit, an old leaf.

name: accumbent
definition: of the orientation of an embryo, with the radicle lying against the edges of the two cotyledons; e.g. some Brassicaceae.

name: achene
definition: dry 1-seeded fruit not opening by valves or regular lines.

name: acicle
definition: (adjective acicular) slender, needle-shaped projection.

name: ACT
definition: Australian Capital Territory.

name: actinomorphic
definition: regular; radially symmetrical; able to be bisected into similar halves in at least two planes; applies to flowers in which the perianth segments within each whorl are alike in size and shape; cf. irregular, zygomorphic.

name: aculeate
definition: armed with prickles, e.g. the stem of a rose.

name: acuminate
definition: tapering gradually to a point. Figure 217d.

name: acute
definition: sharply pointed; converging edges making an angle of less than 90°; cf. obtuse. Figure 217e.

name: adaxial
definition: the side next to the axis; e.g. the upper surface of an erect leaf in respect to a vertical stem.

name: adnate
definition: fused to an organ of a different kind; e.g. a stamen fused to a petal; cf. connate.

name: adventitious
definition: a structure produced in an abnormal position; e.g. an adventitious bud produced from a stem rather than the axil of a leaf.

name: adventive
definition: introduced accidentally (usually referring to weeds).

name: aerial
definition: of the air; growing or borne above the surface of the ground.

name: aestivation
definition: the arrangement of sepals and petals or their lobes in a flower bud.

name: aff.
definition: with affinities to.

name: aggregate fruit
definition: a cluster of fruits formed from the free carpels of one flower; e.g. blackberry.

name: albumen
definition: see endosperm.

name: alternate
definition: [as adjective] leaves or flowers borne singly at different levels along a stem (includes spiralled parts); or [as verb] when something occurs between something else, e.g. stamens alternating with petals; cf. opposite. Figure 216a–b.

name: alveole
definition: (adjective alveolate) a cavity or shallow pit on a surface, often creating a honeycomb-like appearance.

name: amphicarpous
definition: bearing 2 kinds of fruit, differing in morphology or in time of ripening.

name: amphidiploid
definition: a fertile species derived by doubling of the chromosomes from a sterile parent species (e.g. the grass Spartina anglica).

name: amphitropous
definition: when the ovule is bent so that both ends are near each other; cf. anatropous, campylotropous, orthotropous.

name: amplexicaul
definition: with the base dilated and clasping the stem, usually of leaves.

name: ampulliform
definition: swollen at base like a flask.

name: anadromic
definition: with the first branch produced towards apex; usually, with the first lateral vein or pinnule of a pinna directed towards the apex of plant; cf. catadromic.

name: anastomosing
definition: when veins are joined by cross-veins to form a network.

name: anatropous
definition: when an ovule is inverted so that the micropyle faces the placenta (this is the commonest ovule orientation in flowering plants); cf. amphitropous, campylotropous, orthotropous.

name: androdioecious
definition: of plants, having bisexual flowers and male flowers on separate individuals; cf. andromonoecious, polygamodioecious, poly-gamomonoecious, polygamous.

name: androecium
definition: male parts of flower; the stamens of a flower collectively; cf. gynoecium.

name: androgynophore
definition: a stalk bearing both the female and male parts of a flower above the level of insertion of the perianth.

name: androgynous
definition: with male and female flowers in the same inflorescence.

name: andromonoecious
definition: of plants, having bisexual and male flowers on same individual; cf. androdioecious, polygamodioecious, polygamomonoecious, polygamous.

name: angiosperms
definition: 'flowering plantsâ€™; plants with developing seeds enclosed within an ovary.

name: annual
definition: plant which completes its life cycle and dies within one year.

name: annulus
definition: in ferns, the elastic ring of cells (usually with thickened inner and lateral walls) on a sporangium involved in spore release.

name: anterior
definition: see distal; cf. posterior.

name: anther
definition: pollen-bearing part of the stamen.

name: antheridium
definition: male-reproductive organ of a fern gametophyte.

name: anthesis
definition: time of flowering (when the flower opens); in Grevillea, developmental stage at which the pollen is released from the anthers inside the bud onto the pollen-presenter, usually corresponding with flower opening.

name: antrorse
definition: directed forwards or upwards; e.g. of hairs on a stem; cf. retrorse.

name: apiculate
definition: terminating in a short, sharp, flexible point; less abrupt than mucronate.

name: apocarpous
definition: of a gynoecium consisting of one or more carpels that are free from one another (or almost so); e.g. Ranunculaceae, Dilleniaceae.

name: apomictic
definition: reproducing without fertilization.

name: appendiculate
definition: with small appendage or projection.

name: appressed
definition: pressed closely, but not fused; e.g. leaves against a stem.

name: approximate
definition: growing near together.

name: aquatic
definition: living in or on water for all or a substantial part of the life span; generally restricted to fresh or inland waters.

name: arachnoid
definition: like a cobweb, usually from an entanglement of fine whitish hairs; also termed cobwebbed.

name: arborescent
definition: tree-like.

name: archegonium
definition: female reproductive organ of a fern gametophyte.

name: arcole
definition: a space between the lines of a net or netlike pattern; e.g. that part of a leaf surface defined by each of the elements of a vein network.

name: arcuate
definition: curved; bent like a bow.

name: aril
definition: (adjective arillate) a membranous or fleshy appendage (formed by expansion of the funicle) which partly or wholly covers a seed.

name: aristate
definition: with a stiff, bristle-like awn or tip. Figure 217c.

name: article
definition: a segment of a jointed stem or of a fruit with constrictions between the seeds; part of an organ which separates easily from the rest of the organ at a joint or articulation.

name: articulate
definition: jointed; separating freely, leaving a clean scar; e.g. the fronds of certain ferns where they join the rhizome.

name: ascending
definition: spreading horizontally, then becoming erect.

name: asperate
definition: rough with hairs or points.

name: atropous
definition: see orthotropous.

name: attenuate
definition: narrowing gradually. Figure 217j.

name: auct. non
definition: see auctorum non.

name: auctorum non
definition: [Latin] not of author; used to indicate that the preceding name has been misapplied by certain authors and is not that described by the succeeding authority.

name: auricle
definition: (adjective auriculate) ear-shaped lobe.

name: awn
definition: fine bristle-like appendage; e.g. terminating or on the back of glumes and/or lemmas of some grass spikelets.

name: axil
definition: angle formed by leaf or bract and the branch bearing it.

name: axile
definition: on an axis; of a placenta, on the central axis of the ovary.

name: axillary
definition: borne in or arising from the axil of a leaf.

name: axis
definition: line passing through centre of something; usually refers to main stem of a whole plant or inflorescence.

name: barb
definition: hooked projection; lateral or backward-pointing projection on an awn or bristle. Figure 218cc–dd.

name: barbellate
definition: minutely barbed.

name: basifixed
definition: something attached by its base; e.g. an anther attached to the filament.

name: basipetal
definition: developing sequentially from the apex towards the base (i.e. with the youngest towards the base); e.g. of flowers in an inflorescence.

name: beak
definition: a pointed projection.

name: bearded
definition: with tufts of hairs or hair-like appendages.

name: berry
definition: a fleshy fruit not opening by valves or regular lines, with the seeds immersed in the pulp.

name: bi-
definition: two-; e.g. biternate = twice ternate, bipinnate = twice pinnate, bipinnatisect = twice pinnately divided. Figure 218s,v.

name: biennial
definition: plant which completes its life cycle and dies within the second year.

name: bifid
definition: forked; cut in 2 for about half its length. Figure 218x.

name: bilabiate
definition: 2-lipped (see also labiate).

name: bilateral
definition: arranged on opposite sides.

name: bisexual
definition: bearing both male and female reproductive organs; usually, flowers with both stamens and carpels; hermaphrodite.

name: bole
definition: the trunk of a tree, below the lowest branch; cf. canopy.

name: boss
definition: a prominently raised area on the surface of an organ (typically a petal).

name: bract
definition: modified leaf associated with flower or inflorescence, differing in shape, size or colour from other leaves (and without an axillary bud).

name: bracteate
definition: with bracts.

name: bracteole
definition: small bract borne singly or in pairs on pedicel or calyx.

name: bristle
definition: straight stiff hair (smooth or with minute teeth) or upper part of an awn (when the latter is bent and has a lower, stouter, and usually twisted part, called the column). Figure 219b.

name: bud
definition: An undeveloped or immature shoot which may contain a developing leaf, stem or flower/s; enveloped or not by subtending protective scales.

name: bulb
definition: thick storage organ, usually underground, consisting of a stem and leaf bases (the inner ones fleshy).

name: bulbil
definition: small deciduous bulb or tuber formed in the axil of a leaf or pinna; a means of vegetative propagation.

name: bulblet
definition: a bulb arising from another bulb; a bulbel.

name: bullate
definition: blistered or puckered.

name: burr
definition: loosely, a prickly fruit; a rough or prickly propagule consisting of a seed or fruit and associated floral parts or bracts.

name: buttress root
definition: a root growing from the above ground stem or trunk, and providing support.

name: c.
definition: circa; about.

name: caducous
definition: falling off early.

name: caespitose
definition: tufted, e.g. the growth form of some grasses.

name: callus
definition: (plural calli) generally, a protruding mass of tissue; in orchids, fleshy outgrowths from the labellum which can be variously shaped from papillae to plates; in grasses, hardened extension from the base of a floret (formed from the rachilla joint and/or the base of the lemma) which may or may not elongate and is often covered in hairs or bristles.

name: calyx
definition: (plural calyces) the outer whorl of a flower, usually green; the sepals of one flower collectively.

name: campanulate
definition: bell-shaped.

name: campylotropous
definition: when the ovule is orientated transversely (i.e. with its axis at right angles to its stalk) and with a curved embryo sac; cf. amphitropous, anatropous, orthotropous.

name: canaliculate
definition: channelled; with a longitudinal groove.

name: canescent
definition: whitish or pale grey, usually from a covering of short fine hairs.

name: canopy
definition: the branches and foliage of a tree; crown; cf. trunk.

name: capillary
definition: slender, hair-like.

name: capitate
definition: with knob-like head; of an inflorescence, with the flowers unstalked and aggregated into a dense cluster; of a stigma, like the head of a pin.

name: capitulum
definition: (plural capitula) a dense cluster of sessile, or almost sessile, flowers or florets; a head. Figure 220e–f.

name: capsule
definition: a dry fruit formed from two or more united carpels and dehiscing when ripe (usually by splitting into pieces or opening at summit by teeth or pores).

name: carina
definition: (adjective carinate) keel.

name: carpel
definition: a female organ borne at the centre of flower, consisting of an ovary, a style and a stigma; collectively called the gynoecium.

name: carpophore
definition: the central axis of a schizocarp.

name: cartilaginous
definition: hard and tough; gristly.

name: caruncle
definition: a fleshy outgrowth of the seed coat near where it is attached; strophiole.

name: caryopsis
definition: a dry, indehiscent, one-seeded fruit in which the seed coat is closely fused to the fruit wall, e.g. in most grasses.

name: catadromic
definition: first branch produced towards base; usually, with the first lateral vein or pinnule of a pinna directed towards the base of plant; cf. anadromic.

name: cataphyll
definition: (1) an enlarged leaf-sheath, normally the lamina reduced to a small point, e.g. in some Juncus and grass species; (2) a scale leaf associated with a vegetative part of the plant, e.g. a rhizome or perennating bud.

name: catkin
definition: a spike in which the flowers are unisexual and without conspicuous perianth; e.g. in willows.

name: caudex
definition: the axis of a plant (including stem and root).

name: caudicle
definition: a thread to which a pollen mass is attached, e.g. in Orchidaceae, Asclepiadaceae.

name: caulescent
definition: becoming clearly stalked.

name: cauliflorous
definition: see cauline.

name: cauline
definition: borne on an aerial stem, e.g. leaves, flower or fruits (when applied to the latter two organs, usually referring to older stems; = cauliflorous) .

name: cell
definition: (1) basic (microscopic) unit of plant structure, generally consisting of compartments in a viscous fluid surrounded by a wall; (2) cavity of an anther or ovary.

name: centrifixed
definition: of a two-branched organ attached by its centre, e.g. a hair. Figure 218z.

name: channelled
definition: with edges curved round (like a gutter).

name: chartaceous
definition: paper-like in texture.

name: chasmogamous
definition: of flowers that are pollinated when perianth is open; cf. cleistogamous.

name: cilia
definition: (singular cilium, adjective ciliate) generally, hairs more or less confined to the margins of an organ, like eye-lashes. Figure 217s.

name: circinate
definition: spirally coiled with the tip innermost, e.g. the developing fronds of most ferns.

name: circumsciss
definition: (adjective circumscissile) opening along a transverse line, the upper part coming off like a lid.

name: cladode
definition: a photosynthetic stem, often leaf-like and often with foliage leaves either absent or much reduced; cf. phyllode.

name: clathrate
definition: latticed or pierced with apertures, e.g. scales on Asplenium species.

name: clavate
definition: club-shaped.

name: claw
definition: (1) narrow, stalk-like basal portion of petal, sepal or bract; (2) in (e.g.) Melaleuca, united portion of stamen bundle.

name: cleistogamous
definition: of flowers which self-pollinate and never open fully, or self-pollinate before opening; cf. chasmogamous.

name: cleistogene
definition: in grasses, a modified spikelet produced within the lower leaf-sheath(s).

name: cline
definition: (adjective clinal) continuous morphological variation in form within a species, or sometimes, between two species.

name: clone
definition: genetically identical organism produced from a single parent by vegetative reproduction or maturation of ovules in the absence of fertilization.

name: club
definition: of orchids when perianth segment swollen distally and that portion covered in glands or glandular hairs.

name: cm
definition: centimetre.

name: cobwebbed
definition: of hairs when fine and tangled. Figure 219n.

name: colliculate
definition: covered with little rounded protuberances.

name: columella
definition: in flowering plants, the central axis of the cone or fruit, e.g. in Callitris.

name: column
definition: (1) structure extending above ovary and incorporating style and stamens; gynostemium; e.g. in orchids; (2) in grasses, the lower, stouter, and usually twisted part of an awn, distinct from slender upper part or bristle.

name: coma
definition: (adjective comose) an apical tuft, particularly a tuft of hairs on a seed.

name: community
definition: an assemblage of plants in nature which characteristically occur together.

name: compound
definition: composed of several parts, e.g. a leaf with leaflets, a gynoecium with several carpels, an inflorescence made up of an aggregate of smaller inflorescences.

name: compressed
definition: flattened lengthwise, either laterally (from side to side) or dorsally (from front to back).

name: concavo-convex
definition: concave on one side and convex of the opposite side.

name: concolorous
definition: the same colour throughout.

name: conduplicate
definition: folded together, with the fold-line along the long axis.

name: cone
definition: a fruit, usually woody, ovoid to globular, including scales, bracts or bracteoles arranged around a central axis, e.g. in gymnosperms and Casuarinaceae.

name: conflorescence
definition: of an inflorescence when the overall structure is substantially different to that of its parts.

name: conical
definition: cone-shaped, with the broad end at the base.

name: connate
definition: fused to another organ (or organs) of the same kind; e.g. petals in a floral tube; cf. adnate.

name: connective
definition: the part of an anther that connects the lobes.

name: connivent
definition: touching but not fused, e.g. of petals.

name: conspecific
definition: belonging to the same species.

name: contorted
definition: see convolute.

name: convolute
definition: referring to the arrangement of floral or foliar organs in a bud when each organ or segment has one edge overlapping the adjacent organ or segment; a form of imbricate arrangement; contorted.

name: cordate
definition: heart-shaped, with the notch lowermost; of base of leaf, like the notched part of a heart. Figures 216t, 217n.

name: coriaceous
definition: leathery; stiff and tough, but somewhat flexible.

name: corm
definition: fleshy, swollen stem base, usually underground, storing food reserves, with buds naked or covered by very thin scales; a type of rootstock.

name: corolla
definition: inner whorl of non-fertile parts in a flower, often soft and coloured conspicuously; the petals of a flower collectively.

name: corona
definition: literally, crown; in flowering plants, ring of tissue arising from the corolla or perianth of a flower and standing between the perianth lobes and the stamens; in grasses, a hardened ring of tissue surmounting the lemma in some species.

name: corymb
definition: (adjective corymbose) inflorescence with branches starting at different points but reaching about the same height. Figure 220b.

name: costa
definition: (adjective costate) a rib.

name: cotyledon
definition: primary leaf or leaves of an embryo, becoming the seed leaf or leaves.

name: coumarin
definition: a scent, often described as like newly mown hay, e.g. leaves of Sweet Vernal-grass.

name: crenate
definition: with blunt or rounded teeth, scalloped. Figure 218c.

name: crenulate
definition: minutely scalloped. Figure 218b.

name: crisped
definition: finely curled.

name: crown
definition: see canopy.

name: crustaceous
definition: hard, thin and brittle.

name: cryptogams
definition: ferns, bryophytes, algae and fungi (including lichenized fungi); 'lower plantsâ€™; plants producing spores, and without stamens, ovaries or seeds; literally plants whose sexual reproductive organs are not conspicuous; cf. phanerogam.

name: cucullate
definition: hooded; hood-shaped.

name: culm
definition: in grasses, sedges, rushes, and some other monocotyledons, an aerial stem bearing the inflorescence; strictly, from the base of the plant to the lowest involucral bract (or base of inflorescence).

name: cuneate
definition: wedge-shaped; with straight sides converging at base. Figures 216m, 217k.

name: cupule
definition: (adjective cupular) a cup formed by a closely adhering involucre of a fruit.

name: curviveined
definition: (or curvinerved) with curved veins (or nerves).

name: cusp
definition: sharp, rigid point.

name: cuspidate
definition: tipped with a cusp.

name: cyanogenetic
definition: producing hydrocyanic (prussic) acid formed as a result of the hydrolysis of a cyanogenetic glycoside.

name: cyathiform
definition: cup-shaped, a little wider at the top than the bottom.

name: cyathium
definition: an inflorescence of unisexual flowers surrounded by involucral bracts, e.g. in Euphorbia.

name: cymbiform
definition: Boat-shaped; navicular.

name: cyme
definition: (adjective cymose) inflorescence in which the main axis and all lateral branches end in a flower (each lateral may be repeatedly branched).

name: cypsela
definition: a dry, indehiscent, one-seeded fruit formed from an inferior ovary.

name: deciduous
definition: falling seasonally, e.g. bark, leaves, petals; cf. persistent.

name: decorticating
definition: with bark peeling off.

name: decumbent
definition: with branches growing horizontally but turned up at the ends.

name: decurrent
definition: extending downwards beyond the point of insertion, e.g. when the base of leaf or pinna is prolonged downwards along the stem in a raised line or narrow wing.

name: decurved
definition: curved downwards.

name: decussate
definition: opposite, with successive pairs borne at right angles to the last; e.g. leaf arrangement. Figure 216d.

name: definite
definition: of a constant number; e.g. twice as many stamens as the petals or sepals (or less), or an inflorescence ending in a flower or an aborted floral bud; cf. indefinite.

name: deflexed
definition: bent downwards; cf. inflexed.

name: dehiscent
definition: breaking open at maturity to release contents, e.g. anthers, some fruits.

name: deltoid
definition: triangular, with the sides more or less equal in length. Figure 216w.

name: dendroid
definition: (or dendritic) tree-like; branched like a tree.

name: dentate
definition: toothed. Figure 218k.

name: denticulate
definition: finely toothed. Figure 218i.

name: depauperate
definition: reduced in form or vigour.

name: depressed
definition: flattened from above.

name: determinate
definition: limited, usually in growth.

name: diadelphous
definition: having the stamens united into 2 groups, or all but 1 united in a group and 1 free.

name: diam.
definition: diameter.

name: dichasium
definition: a cymose inflorescence with all branches below the terminal flower in regular opposite pairs; cf. monochasium. Figure 220i.

name: dichotomous
definition: forking into 2 equal branches, resulting from an equal division of the growing tip.

name: dicotyledon
definition: a flowering plant whose embryo has 2 (rarely more) cotyledons (seed leaves); cf. monocotyledon.

name: diffuse
definition: spreading horizontally and loosely branched.

name: digitate
definition: with segments spreading from a common centre, like the fingers of a hand; see also palmatisect.

name: dimorphic
definition: of 2 different kinds (in respect to shape and/or size), e.g. stamens, fronds, leaves.

name: dioecious
definition: of plant, with male and female reproductive structures developing on different individuals; cf. monoecious.

name: diploid
definition: see -ploid.

name: disarticulate
definition: to separate at a joint, e.g. deciduous leaves in autumn.

name: disc
definition: a plate or ring of structures derived from the receptacle, and occurring between whorls of floral parts; in daisies, the central part of capitulum, hence disc flowers or florets.

name: discolorous
definition: of leaves, with upper and lower surfaces of a different colour.

name: discrete
definition: separate.

name: dissected
definition: deeply divided; cut into many segments.

name: dissepiment
definition: a partition within an ovary or fruit, usually formed from the fusion of adjacent carpel walls; a septum in an ovary or fruit.

name: distal
definition: remote from the point of attachment or axis; the free end; anterior; cf. proximal.

name: distichous
definition: arranged in two opposite rows (and hence in the same plane). Figure 216b.

name: distinct
definition: separate or free, not united.

name: divaricate
definition: widely spreading.

name: divergent
definition: spreading in different directions.

name: domatia
definition: pits formed at the junction of two veins on the undersurface of leaves (mostly of rainforest plants) and often with modified appendages providing shelter for parasites and other microorganisms.

name: dorsal
definition: the back; in particular, away from axis in lateral organ or away from substratum in prostrate plant.

name: dorsifixed
definition: attached at or by the back, e.g. anthers on a filament.

name: dorsiventral
definition: having structurally different upper and lower surfaces, e.g. some leaves.

name: doubly toothed
definition: when each tooth is again toothed; bidentate.

name: drupaceous
definition: resembling a drupe.

name: drupe
definition: a fleshy fruit formed from one carpel, having the single seed enclosed within an inner stony layer of the fruit wall; e.g. peaches, olives and the fruit of Nitraria billardierei.

name: dyad
definition: a pair of organs.

name: ebracteate
definition: without bracts.

name: echinate
definition: spiny; bearing stiff, stout, prickly hairs.

name: ecotype
definition: (adjective ecotypic) a plant or group of plants exhibiting certain characteristics of growth or flowering in response to particular environmental conditions.

name: ed.
definition: editor.

name: edn
definition: edition.

name: eds
definition: editors.

name: eglandular
definition: without glands.

name: elaisome
definition: an oily or waxy body attached to a seed, characteristically on seeds dispersed by ants.

name: ellipsoid
definition: 3-dimensional shape, elliptic in all sections through long axis.

name: elliptic
definition: shaped like a flattened circle, symmetric about both the long and short axis; oval. Figure 216h.

name: emarginate
definition: notched at apex (notch usually broad and shallow). Figure 217i.

name: embryo
definition: young plant contained within an archegonium or seed.

name: endemic
definition: having a natural distribution restricted to a particular region.

name: endocarp
definition: the innermost layer of the wall of a fruit; in a drupe, the stony layer surrounding the seed.

name: endosperm
definition: nutritive tissue in a seed; albumen.

name: ensiform
definition: shaped like the blade of a sword.

name: entire
definition: having a smooth margin, not lobed, divided or toothed (note that it may be wavy or scalloped, but not incised). Figure 218a.

name: ephemeral
definition: short-lived.

name: epi-
definition: upon; e.g. epipetalous = borne on the petals.

name: epicarp
definition: the outer layer of the wall of a fruit, i.e. the "skin"

name: epidermis
definition: outermost layer of cell of an organ, usually only one cell thick.

name: epigynous
definition: borne on the ovary; used to describe floral parts when inserted above the level of the ovary and arising from tissue fused to the ovary wall; cf. hypogynous, perigynous.

name: epilithic
definition: see lithophytic.

name: epiphyte
definition: (adjective epiphytic) one plant growing on another without deriving nourishment from it (i.e. not parasitic), cf. parasite; loosely, and incorrectly, plants which are not terrestrial (i.e. they may grow on a variety of inorganic or organic surfaces), often used for orchids which are rock-dwelling (and therefore strictly lithophytic).

name: equitant
definition: of a leaf when folded lengthwise with edges adhering except at base, where it clasps another leaf on the opposite side of the stem.

name: erect
definition: upright; more or less perpendicular to the ground or point of attachment.

name: ericoid
definition: with leaves like the European heath {Erica), that is, small and sharply pointed.

name: erose
definition: with the margin irregular as though nibbled or worn away.

name: et al.
definition: et alii; [Latin] and others.

name: Eurasia
definition: the combined continent of Europe and Asia.

name: ex
definition: in nomenclature, indicating that the preceding author proposed but did not legitimately publish the name, and the succeeding author when legitimately publishing the name made reference to the first author.

name: ex-
definition: without; e.g. exalbuminous = without albumen.

name: excurrent
definition: running through to the apex and beyond as a mucro.

name: excurved
definition: curved away from the main axis.

name: exocarp
definition: the combined epicarp and mesocarp of a fruit, i.e. the 'fleshâ€™ and the 'skinâ€™.

name: exotic
definition: not native; introduced from another region or country.

name: exserted
definition: projected beyond, e.g. stamens beyond corolla tube, awn beyond glume.

name: extra-
definition: outside of; beyond; e.g. extrapetiolar, arising from somewhere other than the petiole.

name: extravaginal
definition: of grasses, when the lateral shoot breaks through the subtending leaf-sheath; cf. intravaginal.

name: extrorse
definition: of anther locules, with opening towards outside of flower; cf. introrse, latrorse.

name: f.
definition: if preceding taxon epithet, see forma; if following author of taxon (e.g. Hook. f.), see filius.

name: facultative
definition: of parasites, optional; cf. obligate.

name: falcate
definition: curved like the blade of a scythe. Figure 216r.

name: family
definition: a formal group of one or more genera which share common features and/or ancestry.

name: fascicle
definition: a cluster, e.g. a tuft of leaves all arising from the same node.

name: fastigiate
definition: parallel, clustered and erect, e.g. some poplars.

name: ferruginous
definition: rust-coloured.

name: fertile
definition: capable of producing fruit; of flowers when producing seed or of anthers when containing pollen.

name: fig.
definition: figure.

name: filament
definition: (1) stalk of a stamen; (2) thread, one or a few cells thick.

name: filamentous
definition: consisting of filaments or fibres.

name: filiform
definition: thread-like.

name: filius
definition: [Latin] son.

name: fimbriate
definition: fringed.

name: fistula
definition: the opening of a hollow leaf-base, through which the stem emerges.

name: flabellate
definition: fan-shaped.

name: flaccid
definition: limp; tending to wilt; cf. turgid.

name: flexuous
definition: bent alternately in different directions; zig-zag.

name: floccose
definition: with soft and woolly covering of hairs.

name: flora
definition: (1) all the plants growing in a certain region or country; (2) an enumeration of them, generally with a guide to their identification (e.g. the present volume).

name: floral leaves
definition: the upper leaves at the base of the flowering branches.

name: floral tube
definition: tube bearing the perianth and stamens, consisting of tissue derived from the receptacle and/or perianth and/or stamens; hypanthium.

name: floret
definition: a small flower, especially when part of a larger inflorescence; in grasses, each flower together with lemma and palea that enclose it.

name: flower
definition: the sexual reproductive structure of the angiosperms, typically with a gynoecium, androecium, perianth and an axis.

name: follicle
definition: a dry fruit formed from 1 carpel, splitting along a single suture, to which the seeds are attached; cf. pod (of legume).

name: forest
definition: vegetation dominated by trees with single trunks (including closely arranged trees with or without an understorey of shrubs and herbs).

name: forma
definition: (in common usage, form) [Latin] a taxonomic category subordinate to species, usually differentiated by a minor character.

name: fovea
definition: (adjective foveate) a pit.

name: foveola
definition: (adjective foveolate) a small pit.

name: free
definition: not united with others of the same organ; not attached at one end.

name: frond
definition: the leaf of a fern, cycad or palm.

name: fruit
definition: seed-bearing structure in angiosperms formed from the ovary, and sometimes associated floral parts, after flowering.

name: funicle
definition: the stalk of an ovule.

name: fused
definition: joined together.

name: fusiform
definition: 3-dimensional, tapering gradually from middle towards each end; spindle-shaped.

name: galea
definition: hood or helmet-like structure formed by fusion of the petals and dorsal sepal; e.g. in the orchid genus Pterostylis.

name: gamete
definition: a cell or nucleus that fuses with another of the opposite sex in sexual reproduction.

name: gametophyte
definition: plant that bears gametes; in ferns, usually a small but discrete plant very different from the sporophyte (which is normally considered the fern plant); in gymnosperms and angiosperms, a microscopic structure (part of the reproductive apparatus) not recognizable as a discrete plant; cf. sporophyte.

name: geniculate
definition: bent abruptly like a knee-joint.

name: genus
definition: (plural genera) a group of one or more species which share common features and/or ancestry.

name: gibbous
definition: when part of an organ is swollen; usually, with a pouch-like enlargement at base.

name: glabrescent
definition: becoming glabrous; almost glabrous.

name: glabrous
definition: without surface ornamentation such as hairs, scales or bristles.

name: gland
definition: a secretory structure within or on the surface of a plant; loosely, a smooth, usually shining, bead-like outgrowth.

name: glandular hair
definition: hairs tipped with a gland. Figure 218gg.

name: glaucous
definition: blue-green in colour with a whitish bloom, e.g. the young leaves of many eucalypts.

name: globose
definition: nearly spherical.

name: globulose
definition: small and nearly spherical.

name: glumaceous
definition: resembling a glume.

name: glumes
definition: bracts subtending the floret(s) of a grass, sedge or similar plant and so forming the lowermost organs of a spikelet (in grasses, there are usually 2, but 1 is sometimes reduced or rarely both are absent).

name: glutinous
definition: sticky.

name: grain
definition: the fruit of a grass; caryopsis.

name: granular
definition: of a surface, covered with small rounded protuberances.

name: grass
definition: a plant belonging to the family Poaceae.

name: grassland
definition: low vegetation dominated by grasses.

name: gymnosperm
definition: a seed-bearing plant with ovules borne on the surface of a sporophyll; includes for example, conifers, podocarps.

name: gynobasic
definition: of a style, arising near the base of the gynoecium, e.g. between the lobes of the ovary.

name: gynodioecious
definition: of plants, with female flowers on some individuals and bisexual flowers on others.

name: gynoecium
definition: female parts of flower; the carpels of a flower collectively; the pistil; cf. androecium.

name: gynophore
definition: stalk supporting the gynoecium (above the level of insertion of the other floral parts).

name: gynostemium
definition: see column.

name: habit
definition: the general external appearance of a plant (including size, shape, texture and orientation).

name: habitat
definition: the place where a plant lives; the environmental conditions of its home.

name: hair
definition: an elongated cell or row of cells borne on the surface of an organ either branched (Figure 218ff) or unbranched.

name: half-inferior
definition: of ovary, partly below and partly above the level of attachment of the other floral parts; cf. inferior, superior. Figure 221b.

name: halophyte
definition: a plant adapted to living in highly saline habitats; a plant that accumulates high concentrations of salt in its tissues.

name: hamulus
definition: on column of orchid, thread of tissue between pollen-mass and viscid disk on upper part of stigma (rostellum).

name: haploid
definition: see -ploid.

name: hastate
definition: like the head of a halbert, i.e. narrow and pointed but abruptly enlarged at the base into two acute diverging lobes; may refer only to the base of a leaf with such lobes; cf. sagittate. Figures 216v, 217p.

name: haustorium
definition: a structure present on most parasitic plants, developed for penetration of tissue of host plant.

name: head
definition: see capitulum.

name: heathland
definition: vegetation dominated by small shrubs which usually have ericoid leaves.

name: helicoid
definition: coiled; of a cymose inflorescence, when the branching is repeatedly on the same side (the apex is often recurved); cf. scorpioid.

name: hemi-
definition: half.

name: herb
definition: a vascular plant which does not develop a woody stem; e.g. the violet.

name: herbaceous
definition: not woody; usually green, and soft in texture.

name: hermaphrodite
definition: see bisexual.

name: heterogamous
definition: producing flowers of 2 or more kinds with respect to their fertile organs, i.e. combination of male, female or bisexual; cf. homogamous.

name: heteromorphic
definition: of 2 or more distinct morphologies (i.e. of different size and shape).

name: heterosporous
definition: with spores of 2 kinds (resultant gametophytes produce either male or female gametes).

name: hilum
definition: the scar on a seed coat where it separates from its stalk (funicle).

name: hip
definition: the fruit of a rose; fleshy, hollow and enclosing achenes; cynarrhodium.

name: hirsute
definition: bearing coarse, rough, longish hairs. Figure 219h.

name: hispid
definition: rough with stiff, bristly hairs. Figure 219a.

name: hispidulous
definition: minutely hispid.

name: hoary
definition: covered with a greyish to whitish layer of very short, closely interwoven hairs. Figure 219d.

name: holotype
definition: a type chosen by the author of a name; cf. a lectotype, which is chosen by a later author.

name: homogamous
definition: having flowers of only one kind; cf. heterogamous.

name: homosporous
definition: with spores all of the one sort (resultant gametophytes produce both male and female gametes).

name: hyaline
definition: translucent; usually delicately membranous and colourless.

name: hybrid
definition: an offspring of genetically different parents; usually, when the parents belong to different taxa.

name: hypanthium
definition: see floral tube.

name: hypogynous
definition: borne below the ovary; used to describe floral parts when inserted below the level of insertion of the ovary; cf. epigynous, perigynous.

name: imbricate
definition: overlapping each other; of perianth parts, having edges overlapping in the bud (the convolute arrangement is a special form of imbrication).

name: imparipinnate
definition: a pinnate leaf with an odd number of pinnae (terminated by a single leaflet); cf. paripinnate. Figure 218q.

name: in
definition: in nomenclature, where the preceding author published the name in an article or book, authored or edited by the succeeding author.

name: incised
definition: cut deeply and (usually) unevenly (a condition intermediate between toothed and lobed). Figure 218l.

name: inclined
definition: orientated at an angle of 45–80°.

name: included
definition: enclosed, not protruding; e.g. stamens within the corolla.

name: incumbent
definition: lying against another organ; e.g. cotyledons when lying face to face, or anther when lying against the inner face of the filament.

name: incurved
definition: bent or curved inwards; of leaf margins, when curved towards the adaxial side. Figure 217u.

name: indefinite
definition: variable in number; numerous; e.g. more than twice as many stamens as petals or sepals, or when an inflorescence is not terminated by a flower (and continues growing); cf. definite.

name: indehiscent
definition: not opening in any definite manner at maturity; usually referring to fruit.

name: indeterminate
definition: unlimited, usually in growth.

name: indumentum
definition: any surface covering, e.g. hairs, scales; a collective term for such coverings.

name: induplicate
definition: with margins bent inwards and external face of edges applied to one anther.

name: indurated
definition: hardened.

name: indusium
definition: (1) a membrane covering the sporangia of some ferns; (2) a cup enclosing the stigma in Goodeniaceae.

name: inferior
definition: of an ovary, entirely or mostly below the level of attachment of other floral parts; cf. superior, half-inferior. Figure 221c.

name: inflated
definition: swollen; like a bladder.

name: inflexed
definition: bent sharply upwards or forwards; cf. deflexed.

name: inflorescence
definition: the group or arrangement of flowers on a plant. Figure 220.

name: infructescence
definition: the group or arrangement of fruits on a plant.

name: inrolled
definition: rolled inwards.

name: insectivorous
definition: catching, and drawing nutriment from, insects.

name: interjugary glands
definition: in pinnate leaves, glands occurring along the leaf rachis between the pinnae (occurring below the single, and often slightly larger, gland which is found at or just below the insertion of the pinnae).

name: internerve
definition: portion of leaf between nerves.

name: internode
definition: the portion of a stem between two nodes.

name: interpetiolar
definition: of stipules, between the petioles of opposite leaves.

name: interrupted
definition: with bare space between the parts; of an inflorescence, with flowers unevenly distributed along the axis, with conspicuous gaps.

name: intramarginal
definition: situated inside but close to the margin, e.g. a vein in a leaf.

name: intravaginal
definition: of grasses, when the lateral shoot does not break through the subtending leaf-sheath; cf. extravaginal.

name: introrse
definition: of anther locules, with opening towards the centre of flower (at least in bud); cf. extrorse, latrorse.

name: involucre
definition: (adjective involucral) a group of bracts surrounding the base of a flowerhead; in Hymenophyllaceae, a layer of tissue enveloping the sporangia.

name: involute
definition: rolled inwards; e.g. when the margins of a leaf are rolled towards the adaxial (usually upper) surface; cf. revolute. Figure 217v.

name: irregular
definition: cannot be divided into 2 equal halves through any vertical plane; cf. zygomorphic, actinomorphic.

name: irritable
definition: responding suddenly to stimuli, e.g. the labellum of some orchids and members of the trigger-plant family.

name: Is.
definition: Island.

name: isobilateral
definition: see isolateral.

name: isodiametric
definition: of equal dimensions, e.g. a cube.

name: isolateral
definition: having structurally similar upper and lower surfaces.

name: joint
definition: a node or junction of 2 parts; articulation.

name: juvenile leaves
definition: formed on a young plant; sometimes different in form from the adult leaves.

name: keel
definition: a ridge like the keel of a boat, e.g. the structure formed by the fusion of the two anterior petals of a flower in the Fabaceae.

name: kernel
definition: the seed of a nut, drupe or pyrene.

name: kino
definition: reddish, astringent exudation from the bark or wood, e.g. some Myrtaceae.

name: km
definition: kilometre.

name: labellum
definition: lip; 1 of 3 or 5 petals which is (usually) different from the others, e.g. in Orchidaceae and Stylidiaceae.

name: labiate
definition: lipped; where the limb of a corolla or a calyx is divided into 2 parts, called an upper and lower lip.

name: lacerate
definition: jagged, as if torn.

name: laciniate
definition: slashed into narrow, pointed lobes. Figure 218m.

name: lageniform
definition: shaped like a flask or a wine bottle; fusiform below and tapering apically to a distinct slender neck

name: lamella
definition: (plural lamellae, adjective lamellate) a thin, plate-like layer.

name: lamina
definition: the blade of a leaf or the expanded upper part of a petal, sepal or bract.

name: lanceolate
definition: about 4 times as long as broad, broadest in the lower half and tapering to the tip; narrowly ovate (sometimes, and incorrectly, used for narrowly elliptic); like a lance. Figure 216q.

name: lateral
definition: attached to the side of an organ, e.g. leaves on a stem.

name: latrorse
definition: along the sides, sidewards; of anther locules, with opening on the side (tangential); cf. extrorse, introrse.

name: lax
definition: loose, not compact.

name: leaflets
definition: the ultimate segments of a compound leaf.

name: legume
definition: see pod.

name: lemma
definition: the lower of 2 bracts enclosing a grass flower.

name: lenticel
definition: a loosely packed mass of cells in the bark of a woody plant (used for gas exchange), visible on the surface as a raised powdery spot.

name: lenticular
definition: shaped like a biconvex lens; disc-shaped but with convex sides.

name: liane
definition: a woody climbing or twining plant.

name: lianoid
definition: having a liane-like habit.

name: lignotuber
definition: a woody swelling of the stem below or just above the ground (contains adventitious buds from which new shoots can develop, e.g. after fire).

name: ligulate
definition: (1) bearing a ligule; (2) strap-shaped.

name: ligule
definition: (1) small membranous appendage on the top of the sheath of grass leaves; (2) a minute adaxial appendage near the base of a leaf, e.g. in Isoetes and Selaginella; (3) extended, strap-like corolla of some daisy florets.

name: limb
definition: upper, free, spreading portion of a corolla or perianth above the united part or tube.

name: linear
definition: very narrow in relation to its length, with the sides mostly parallel. Figure 216f.

name: lithophytic
definition: growing on rocks; epilithic.

name: lobe
definition: part of a leaf (or other organ), often rounded, formed by incisions about half-way to the midrib. Figure 218e.

name: lobule
definition: a small lobe.

name: loculicidal
definition: of a fruit, when it dehisces through the centres of loculi; cf. septicidal.

name: lodicules
definition: a pair of tiny scales in a grass floret, between the lemma and the fertile parts of the flower.

name: lomentum
definition: a legume (fruit) contracted between seeds and breaking into one-seeded segments when mature.

name: long-creeping
definition: in ferns, a rhizome which elongates rapidly so that the fronds are usually distant; cf. short-creeping.

name: lunate
definition: crescent-shaped.

name: lyrate
definition: lyre-shaped; deeply lobed, with a large terminal lobe and smaller lateral ones. Figure 218t.

name: Malesia
definition: a biogeographic region comprising Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines and Papua New Guinea.

name: mallee
definition: growth habit in which several woody stems arise separately from a lignotuber; a plant with such a growth habit; vegetation characterized by such plants.

name: mangrove
definition: a shrub or small tree growing in salt or brackish water, usually characterized by pneumatophores.

name: marginal
definition: occurring at or very close to the margin.

name: maritime
definition: belonging to the sea; confined to the coast.

name: marsh
definition: a waterlogged area; swamp.

name: massula
definition: (plural massulae) a hardened mucilaginous mass enclosing microspores.

name: mealy
definition: covered with coarse, flour-like powder (sometimes due to collapsed hairs).

name: megasporangium
definition: the larger of 2 kinds of sporangia produced by a heterosporous plant; cf. microsporangium.

name: megaspore
definition: the larger of 2 kinds of spores produced by a heterosporous plant, giving rise to the female gametophyte; cf. microspore.

name: megasporophyll
definition: a specialized leaf bearing (on its surface or in its axil) one or more megasporangia; cf. microsporophyll.

name: MEL
definition: internationally used abbreviation for the National Herbarium of Victoria.

name: membranous
definition: thin, translucent and flexible, usually not green.

name: mericarp
definition: one segment of a fruit (a schizocarp) that splits at maturity into units derived from the individual carpels.

name: mesic
definition: requiring abundant water.

name: mesocarp
definition: the fleshy portion of the wall of a succulent fruit inside the skin and outside the stony layer, if any, surrounding the seed(s); sarcocarp.

name: mesomorphic
definition: soft and with little fibrous tissue, but not succulent.

name: mesophyll
definition: photosynthetic tissue of a leaf; of vegetation, characteristic of moist habitats and with soft, fairly large leaves predominating.

name: Micronesia
definition: a federation of island States in the western Pacific Ocean, comprising the Mariana, Marshall, Caroline and Gilbert Islands groups.

name: microsporangium
definition: the smaller of 2 kinds of sporangia produced by a heterosporous plant; cf. megasporangium.

name: microspore
definition: the smaller of 2 kinds of spores produced by a heterosporous plant; cf. megaspore.

name: microsporophyll
definition: a specialized leaf bearing (on its surface or in its axil) 1 or more microsporangia; cf. megasporophyll.

name: midrib
definition: the central, and usually most prominent, vein of a leaf or leaf-like organ; midvein.

name: midvein
definition: see midrib.

name: mm
definition: millimetre.

name: moniliform
definition: resembling a string of beads.

name: monocarpic
definition: with a normal life cycle of flowering and fruiting only once then dying; includes, but not restricted to, annuals

name: monochasium
definition: a cymose inflorescence with the branches arising singly; cf. dichasium. Figure 220h.

name: monocotyledon
definition: a flowering plant whose embryo has one cotyledon (seed leaf); cf. dicotyledon.

name: monoecious
definition: of [vascular] plants, having the male and female reproductive structures in separate flowers but on the same plant; cf. dioecious.

name: monotypic
definition: containing only one taxon of the next lower rank, e.g. a family with only 1 genus.

name: Mt
definition: Mount.

name: Mtn
definition: Mountain.

name: Mtns
definition: Mountains.

name: mucro
definition: a sharp, short point.

name: mucronate
definition: terminating in a mucro. Figure 217a–b.

name: multicellular hairs
definition: hairs consisting of more than 1 cell. Figure 218y.

name: multiple fruit
definition: a conglomeration of fruits, each formed by one flower, into a structural unit, e.g. the 'burrsâ€™ of Acaena novae-zelandiae.

name: muricate
definition: covered with short, hard-pointed protuberances.

name: naked
definition: of sporangia, without indusium; of seeds, exposed on the surface of a sporophyll (not enclosed within an ovary); of flowers, without perianth.

name: napiform
definition: turnip-shaped.

name: naturalized
definition: of a taxon native outside Victoria but now freely reproducing in well established populations in this State. Such taxa are prefixed with an asterisk (*).

name: nautiloid
definition: spiralled like the shell of a Nautilus.

name: navicular
definition: Boat-shaped, often taken to mean shaped like the prow of a boat, as e.g. the glumes or leaf-tips of some grasses.

name: nectar
definition: a (usually sweet) fluid produced by the flowers of many plants, collected by bees and other insects.

name: nectary
definition: (adjective nectariferous) a specialized gland that secretes nectar.

name: nerve
definition: see vein.

name: node
definition: the part of a stem where leaves or branches arise.

name: nodulose
definition: with small swellings or knobs.

name: nom. cons.
definition: see nomen conservandum.

name: nom. illeg.
definition: see nomen illegitimum.

name: nom. nud.
definition: see nomen nudum.

name: nomen conservandum
definition: [Latin] a name which, although contrary to the rules of nomenclature (usually a later synonym), must be adopted.

name: nomen illegitimum
definition: [Latin] a name which, at its time of publication, was superfluous (because the taxon to which it was applied had already been named) or had already been applied to another plant.

name: nomen nudum
definition: [Latin] a name not published in accordance with the International Code of Botanical Nomenclature (usually without a diagnosis or description of the entity to which it applies, and without reference to either); such a name should not be used.

name: nomenclature
definition: the names and naming of things; often restricted to the correct usage of scientific names in taxonomy.

name: non
definition: [Latin] not of.

name: NSW
definition: New South Wales.

name: NT
definition: Northern Territory.

name: nut
definition: a hard, dry, indehiscent fruit containing only 1 seed.

name: ob-
definition: inversely; usually same shape as suffix but attached by the narrower end, e.g. obconical, obcordate, oblanceolate, obovate, obovoid. Figure 216k,n-o.

name: obligate
definition: of parasites, unable to survive without the host; cf. facultative.

name: oblique
definition: slanting; of leaf, larger on one side of the midrib than the other, i.e. asymmetric. Figure 217q.

name: obloid
definition: 3-dimensional equivalent of oblong; as if composed of 2 hemispheres connected by a short cylinder of equal diameter.

name: oblong
definition: length a few times greater than width, with sides almost parallel and ends rounded. Figure 216g.

name: obtrullate
definition: kite-shaped.

name: obtuse
definition: blunt or rounded; converging edges making an angle of more than 90°; cf. acute. Figure 217f,l.

name: ochrea
definition: a sheath (formed from 2 stipules) encircling the node in Polygonaceae.

name: ontogeny
definition: the sequence of stages through which an organism develops.

name: operculum
definition: a lid or cover that becomes detached at maturity, e.g. in Eucalyptus, a cap covering the bud and formed by fusion or cohesion of perianth parts.

name: opposite
definition: leaves or flowers borne at the same level but on opposite sides of the axis; or when something occurs on the same radius as something else, e.g. anthers opposite sepals; cf. alternate. Figure 216c–d.

name: orbicular
definition: flat and more or less circular. Figure 216j.

name: order
definition: a group of one or more families which share common features and/or ancestry.

name: orthotropous
definition: when an ovule is erect, with the micropyle directed away from the placenta; atropous; cf. amphitropous, anatropous, cam-pylotropous.

name: osteole
definition: opening or pore.

name: oval
definition: see elliptic.

name: ovary
definition: the basal portion of a carpel or group of fused carpels, enclosing the ovule(s).

name: ovate
definition: shaped like a section through the long axis of an egg and attached by the wider end. Figure 216u.

name: ovoid
definition: egg-shaped, with wider portion at base; three-dimensional object, ovate in all sections through long axis.

name: ovule
definition: loosely, the seed before fertilization; a structure in a seed plant within which 1 or more megaspores are formed (following fertilization it develops into a seed).

name: p.p.
definition: see pro parte.

name: palea
definition: the upper of 2 bracts enclosing a grass flower.

name: palmate
definition: divided into several leaflets arising from the same point. Figure 218p.

name: palmatifid
definition: deeply divided into several lobes which arise from more or less the same level. Figure 218w.

name: palmatisect
definition: intermediate between palmate and palmatifid, i.e. with the segments not fully separated at the base; often more or less digitate.

name: panicle
definition: (adjective paniculate) a compound raceme; an indeterminate inflorescence in which the flowers are borne on branches of the main axis or on further branches of these. Figure 220a.

name: papilionate
definition: butterfly-like; with a corolla like that of a pea.

name: papilla
definition: (plural papillae, adjective papillose or papillate) a small, elongated protuberance on the surface of an organ, usually an extension of one epidermal cell.

name: pappus
definition: in daisy florets, a tuft or ring of hairs or scales borne above the ovary and outside the corolla (representing the missing calyx); a tuft of hairs on a fruit.

name: parasite
definition: an organism living on or in a different organism, from which it derives nourishment; cf. saprophyte, epiphyte.

name: parietal
definition: attached to the marginal walls of a structure, e.g. ovules attached to placentas on the wall of the ovary.

name: paripinnate
definition: having an even number of pinnae (terminated by a pair of pinnae); cf. imparipinnate. Figure 218r.

name: patent
definition: spreading.

name: pectinate
definition: pinnately divided with narrow segments closely set like the teeth of a comb.

name: pedate
definition: palmately divided with each of the lobes divided in two.

name: pedicel
definition: (adjective pedicellate) the stalk of a flower.

name: peduncle
definition: (adjective pedunculate) the stalk of an inflorescence.

name: pellucid
definition: transparent.

name: peltate
definition: shield-like; with stalk attached to the lower surface and not to margin. Figures 217r, 218bb.

name: pendulous
definition: hanging, e.g. an ovule attached to a placenta on the summit of the ovary; cf. suspended.

name: penicillate
definition: tufted like an artistâ€™s brush; with long hairs towards one end.

name: penninervation
definition: (adjective penninerved) with pinnately arranged veins.

name: perennial
definition: a plant whose life span extends over several years.

name: perfect
definition: of a flower, when bisexual.

name: perfoliate
definition: with its base wrapped around the stem (so that stem appears to pass through it), e.g. of leaves and bracts.

name: perianth
definition: the calyx and corolla of a flower collectively (particularly used when the two are similar).

name: pericarp
definition: the wall of a fruit, developed from the ovary wall.

name: perigynous
definition: borne around the ovary, i.e. of perianth segments and stamens arising from a cuplike or tubular extension of receptacle (free from the ovary but extending above its base); cf. epigynous, hypogynous.

name: pers. comm.
definition: personal communication; information gained from other than published sources.

name: persistent
definition: remaining attached to the plant beyond the usual time of falling, e.g. of sepals not falling after flowering; cf. deciduous.

name: petal
definition: in a flower, 1 of the segments or divisions of the inner whorl of non-fertile parts surrounding the fertile organs, usually soft and coloured conspicuously; cf. sepal.

name: petaloid
definition: like a petal; soft in texture and coloured conspicuously.

name: petiolate
definition: subtended by a petiole.

name: petiole
definition: the stalk of a leaf.

name: petiolule
definition: the stalk of a leaflet.

name: phanerogam
definition: gymnosperms and angiosperms; plants producing stamens and gynoecia; literally, plants with conspicuous sexual reproductive organs; cf. cryptogam.

name: phyllode
definition: (adjective phyllodinous) a leaf with the blade much reduced or absent, and in which the petiole and or rachis perform the functions of the whole leaf; e.g. many acacias; cf. cladode.

name: phytomelan
definition: black, structureless layer in pericarp, e.g. in many Asteraceae and Smilacaeae.

name: pilose
definition: with soft hairs. Figure 219m.

name: pinna
definition: (plural pinnae) a primary segment of a compound leaf.

name: pinnate
definition: a compound leaf with leaflets arranged on each side of a common petiole or axis; may also be applied to the arrangement of lateral veins in relation to the main vein. Figure 218q–r.

name: pinnatifid
definition: pinnately lobed. Figure 218f.

name: pinnatisect
definition: pinnately divided almost to midrib but segments still confluent. Figure 218g,n.

name: pinnule
definition: ultimate free division (or leaflet) of a compound leaf.

name: pistil
definition: see gynoecium.

name: pistillode
definition: sterile gynoecium, may be rudimentary.

name: pl.
definition: plate.

name: placenta
definition: the tissue within an ovary to which the ovules are attached.

name: placentation
definition: the arrangement of ovules inside ovary; e.g. axile (Figure 221h), free-central (Figure 221i), parietal (Figure 221g), marginal (Figure 221f), basal (Figure 221d), apical (Figure 221e).

name: plano-convex
definition: flat on one side, convex on the other.

name: plicate
definition: pleated; folded back and forth longitudinally like a fan.

name: plumose
definition: like a feather; with fine hairs branching from a main axis.

name: plumule
definition: that part of an embryo giving rise to the shoot system of a plant; cf. radicle.

name: pluritubular
definition: with 2 or more internal, longitudinal tubes; e.g. the culms of some sedges, the leaves of some rushes.

name: pneumatophore
definition: a vertical, aerial (at low tide) appendage to the roots of some plants, through which gases are exchanged; e.g. on mangroves.

name: pod
definition: (1) a legume, the fruit of a leguminous plant, a dry fruit of a single carpel, splitting along 2 sutures; (2) siliqua and silicula, the fruit of Bras-sicaceae, a dry fruit composed of 2 carpels separated by a partition.

name: pollen
definition: powdery mass shed from anthers (of angiosperms) or microsporangia (of gymnosperms); the microspores of seed plants; pollen-grains.

name: pollen-mass
definition: pollen-grains cohering by a waxy texture or fine threads into a single body; pollinium; e.g. in orchids.

name: pollen-presenter
definition: in Proteaceae, discoid or conical face (often slightly shiny) at the end of style onto which pollen is deposited from the anthers prior to anthesis (the stigma is usually central on the pollen-presenter).

name: pollination
definition: the transfer of pollen from the male organ (anther) to the receptive region of a female organ (stigma).

name: pollinium
definition: see pollen-mass.

name: polygamodioecious
definition: having bisexual and male flowers on some plants, and bisexual and female flowers on others; cf. androdioecious, andromonoecious, polygamomonoecious, polygamous.

name: polygamomonoecious
definition: having male, female and bisexual flowers on the same plant; cf. androdioecious, andromonoecious, polygamodioecious, polygamous.

name: polygamous
definition: having bisexual and unisexual flowers on the same plant.

name: polymorphic
definition: of several different kinds (in respect to shape and/or size).

name: polyploid
definition: with more than 2 of the basic sets of chromosomes in the nucleus.

name: pome
definition: fleshy fruit produced below insertion of perianth parts, the receptacle or hypanthium enlarging to enclose the true fruit, e.g. apple.

name: posterior
definition: see proximal; cf. anterior.

name: prickle
definition: hard, pointed outgrowth from the surface of a plant (involving several layers of cells but not containing a vein); sharp outgrowth from bark, detachable without tearing wood; cf. thorn. Figure 219c.

name: pro parte
definition: [Latin] in part; in nomenclature, to denote that the preceding taxon includes more than 1 currently recognized entity, and only 1 of those entities is being considered.

name: pro parte major
definition: [Latin] in the most part; in nomenclature, as above, but when the entity being considered constituted most of the preceding taxon.

name: procumbent
definition: spreading along the ground but not rooting at the nodes: not as close to ground as prostrate.

name: proliferous
definition: of plants which bear bulbils.

name: propagule
definition: a structure capable of producing a new plant; includes seeds, spores, bulbils, etc.

name: prophyll
definition: a leaf formed at the base of a shoot, usually smaller than those formed later.

name: prostrate
definition: lying flat on the ground.

name: protandrous
definition: having the male sex organs maturing before the female ones, e.g. a flower shedding pollen before the stigma is receptive; cf. protogynous.

name: prothallus
definition: a gametophyte body; e.g. in ferns.

name: protogynous
definition: having the female sex organs maturing before the male ones, e.g. a flower shedding pollen after the stigma has ceased to be receptive; cf. protandrous.

name: proximal
definition: near to the point of attachment or axis, posterior; cf. distal.

name: pruinose
definition: covered with a powdery, waxy material; with a 'bloomâ€™.

name: pseudo-
definition: false; apparently but not genuine; e.g. pseudo-bulb = a thickened, bulb-like internode in orchids, or a corm.

name: puberulous
definition: covered with minute, soft, erect hairs. Figure 219j.

name: pubescent
definition: downy; covered with short, soft, erect hairs. Figure 219k.

name: pulvinus
definition: a swelling at the base of a leaf or leaflet stalk, often glandular or responsive to touch.

name: punctate
definition: marked with dots.

name: pustule
definition: (adjective pustulate) pimple or blister.

name: pyrene
definition: the hard endocarp plus seed (the stone), usually of a fleshy fruit.

name: pyriform
definition: pear-shaped.

name: Qld
definition: Queensland.

name: quadrate
definition: more or less square.

name: quadri-
definition: four.

name: raceme
definition: (adjective racemose) an indeterminate inflorescence in which the main axis produces a series of flowers on lateral stalks, the oldest at the base and the youngest at the top; cf. spike. Figure 220c.

name: rachilla
definition: the axis of a grass spikelet, above the glumes.

name: rachis
definition: (plural rachises; rhachis) the axis of an inflorescence or a pinnate leaf, distal to and including the lowermost pedicel attachment, e.g. ferns; secondary rachis is the axis of a pinna in a bipinnate leaf.

name: radiate
definition: of daisies, when the flowerhead has ligulate flowers around the circumference and tubular flowers in the centre.

name: radical
definition: springing from the root; clustered at base of stem.

name: radicle
definition: the part of an embryo giving rise to the shoot system of a plant; cf. plumule.

name: rainforest
definition: in Victoria, mesic vegetation dominated by trees other than eucalypts, often with lianas and epiphytes.

name: ray
definition: (1) zygomorphic (ligulate) flowers in a radiate flowerhead, i.e. ray-florets/flowers, e.g. Asteraceae; (2) each of the branches of an umbel.

name: receptacle
definition: the axis of a flower, i.e.. floral axis; torus; in e.g. Asteraceae, floral base or common receptacle is the expanded summit of the peduncle on which the flowers are inserted.

name: recurved
definition: bent or curved backwards or downwards. Figure 217w.

name: reflexed
definition: bent sharply backwards or downwards.

name: regular
definition: see actinomorphic.

name: renascent
definition: dying down each year and regrowing from below-ground parts.

name: reniform
definition: kidney-shaped. Figure 216x.

name: replum
definition: of Brassicaceae, the rim of pod after valves have fallen.

name: resupinate
definition: organ twisted through 180°, e.g. petiole of a leaf twisted so that the adaxial surface is uppermost, or, flower inverted by a twisting of the pedicel or ovary so that the parts usually lowermost become the uppermost (as in most orchids, resulting in the labellum being lowermost in the open flower).

name: reticulate
definition: forming a network (or reticulum), e.g. veins which join one another at more than one point.

name: retrorse
definition: directed backwards or downwards; cf. antrorse.

name: retuse
definition: with a blunt (obtuse) and slightly notched apex. Figure 217h.

name: revolute
definition: rolled under (downwards or backwards), e.g. when the edges of leaves are rolled under towards the midrib; cf. involute. Figure 217x.

name: rhachis
definition: see rachis.

name: rhizoid
definition: thread-like, unicellular absorbing structure, e.g. in fern gametophytes.

name: rhizome
definition: (adjective rhizomatous) an underground stem, usually growing horizontally; in ferns, used more generally to include prostrate creeping and short erect stems below or just above the ground.

name: rhombic
definition: like a rhombus, i.e. an oblique figure with four equal sides; cf. obtrullate, trapeziform, trullate. Figure 216i.

name: rhomboid
definition: a four-sided figure with opposite sides parallel but adjacent sides of unequal length (i.e. like an oblique rectangle); see also rhombic.

name: rootstock
definition: short, erect, swollen structure at junction of the root and shoot systems of a plant, e.g. a corm.

name: rosette
definition: when parts are not whorled or opposite, but appear so due to the contractions of internodes, e.g. the petals in a double rose or a basal cluster of leaves (usually when close to the ground) in some plants.

name: rostellum
definition: beak-like upward extension of the stigma in orchids.

name: rostrate
definition: with a beak.

name: rosulate
definition: leaves arranged in a basal rosette.

name: rotate
definition: circular and flattened; e.g. of a corolla with a very short tube and spreading lobes (e.g. some Solanaceae).

name: rugose
definition: wrinkled.

name: rugulose
definition: finely wrinkled.

name: ruminate
definition: with an appearance of having been chewed.

name: runcinate
definition: a pinnatifid leaf with lobes pointing towards the base. Figure 218u.

name: runner
definition: see stolon.

name: rush
definition: a plant belonging to the family Juncaceae or, more loosely, to various monocotyledons.

name: s. lat.
definition: see sensu lato.

name: s. str.
definition: see sensu stricto.

name: SA
definition: South Australia.

name: saccate
definition: pouched.

name: sagittate
definition: shaped like the head of an arrow; narrow and pointed but gradually enlarged at base into two straight lobes which are directed downwards; may refer only to the base of a leaf with such lobes; cf. hastate. Figures 216s, 217o.

name: samara
definition: a dry, indehiscent fruit with its wall expanded into a wing.

name: samphire
definition: (in Australia) any plant of the tribe Salicorniae (Chenopodiaceae), e.g. Sarcocornia, Halosarcia, Sclerostegia, or, a community dominated by one or more of these species.

name: saprophyte
definition: (adjective saprophytic) an organism deriving its nourishment from decaying organic matter and usually lacking chlorophyll; cf. parasite, epiphyte.

name: sarcocarp
definition: see mesocarp.

name: scaberulous
definition: minutely roughened.

name: scabrous
definition: rough to touch. Figure 219e.

name: scale
definition: (1) a reduced or rudimentary leaf, e.g. around a dormant bud; (2) a thin flap of tissue. Figure 218hh.

name: scape
definition: (adjective scapose) a stem-like, flowering stalk of a plant with radical leaves.

name: scarious
definition: dry and membranous.

name: schizocarp
definition: a dry fruit formed from more than one carpel but breaking apart into individual carpels (mericarps) when ripe.

name: sclerophyll
definition: (adjective sclerophyllous) a plant with hard, stiff leaves; leaves stiffened with thick-walled cells.

name: scorpioid
definition: of a cymose inflorescence, when it branches alternately on one side and then the other; cf. helicoid.

name: scrub
definition: dense vegetation dominated by shrubs.

name: scuttate
definition: shield-like.

name: section
definition: a taxonomic grouping, in rank between species and genus.

name: secund
definition: with organs (e.g. leaves, branches, flowers) grouped on one side or turned to one side.

name: sedge
definition: a plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae.

name: seed
definition: a ripened ovule, consisting of a protective coat enclosing an embryo and food reserves; a propagating organ formed in the sexual reproductive cycle of gymnosperms and angiosperms (together, the seed plants).

name: segment
definition: part or subdivision of an organ, e.g. a petal is a segment of the corolla.

name: sensu
definition: [Latin] in the sense of.

name: sensu lato
definition: [Latin] of a plant name, in the broad sense.

name: sensu stricto
definition: [Latin] of a plant name, in the narrow sense.

name: sepal
definition: in a flower, one of the segments or divisions of the outer whorl of non-fertile parts surrounding the fertile organs, usually green; cf. petal.

name: septicidal
definition: of a fruit, when it dehisces along the partitions between loculi; cf. loculicidal.

name: septifragal
definition: of a capsule, when the partitions remain attached to the axis, but break away from the edges of the valves.

name: septum
definition: (plural septa, adjective septate) an internal partition; in ovary and fruits, a dissepiment; septate-nodulose is used when the organ is swollen or prominent at the septa region.

name: sericeous
definition: silky with dense appressed hairs.

name: series
definition: taxonomic rank, below genus, but above species

name: serrate
definition: toothed with asymmetrical teeth pointing forward; like the cutting edge of a saw. Figure 218j.

name: serrulate
definition: finely serrate. Figure 218h.

name: sessile
definition: without a stalk, e.g. of a stigma, when the style is absent.

name: seta
definition: (adjective setiform) a bristle or stiff hair (in Bryophytes, the stalk of the sporophyte); a terminal seta is an appendage to the tip of an organ, e.g. the primary rachis of a bipinnate leaf in Acacia.

name: setaceous
definition: bristle-like.

name: setose
definition: bristly.

name: sheath
definition: a tubular or rolled part of an organ, e.g. the lower part of the leaf in most grasses.

name: short-creeping
definition: in ferns, a rhizome which elongates slowly so that the fronds are usually clustered; cf. long-creeping.

name: shrub
definition: a woody perennial plant without a single main trunk and smaller than a tree.

name: sigmoid
definition: shaped like the letter 'Sâ€™.

name: siliceous
definition: glassy; (less commonly) containing silica.

name: silicula
definition: a stout siliqua (not more than twice as long as wide).

name: siliqua
definition: a dry, dehiscent fruit (more than twice as long as wide) formed from a superior ovary of two carpels, with two parietal placentas and divided into two loculi by a 'falseâ€™ septum.

name: silky
definition: densely covered in fine, appressed, shiny hairs. Figure 219l.

name: simple
definition: undivided, e.g. a leaf not divided into leaflets (note, however, that a simple leaf may be entire, toothed or lobed) or an unbranched hair or inflorescence.

name: sinuate
definition: with deep, wave-like depressions along the margins, but more or less flat; cf. undulate. Figure 218d.

name: sinus
definition: a notch or depression in the margin.

name: smut
definition: fungal disease in which black sooty masses of spores cover the affected parts.

name: sorus
definition: a discrete cluster of sporangia.

name: spadix
definition: a spicate inflorescence with a stout, often succulent axis.

name: spathe
definition: a large bract ensheathing an inflorescence.

name: spathulate
definition: spoon-shaped; broad at the tip and narrowed towards the base. Figure 216l.

name: species
definition: a group of individuals, or populations of individuals, which share common features and/ or ancestry, generally the smallest group which can readily and consistently be recognized; often, a group of individuals capable of interbreeding and producing fertile offspring.

name: spike
definition: (adjective spicate) an unbranched, indeterminate inflorescence in which the flowers are without stalks; cf. raceme. Figure 220g.

name: spikelet
definition: a unit of the inflorescence in grasses, sedges and some other monocotyledons, consisting of one to many flowers and associated bracts (glumes).

name: spine
definition: a stiff, sharp structure, formed by the modification of a plant organ, e.g. a lateral branch or a stipule; includes thorns.

name: spinescent
definition: ending in a spine; modified to form a spine.

name: spinule
definition: a small spine.

name: spiral
definition: borne at different levels on the axis, in an ascending spiral. Figure 216a.

name: sporangium
definition: a structure in which spores are formed.

name: spore
definition: in non-flowering plants only, a simple propagule, produced either sexually or asexually, and consisting of one or a few cells.

name: sporocarp
definition: a fruiting body containing spores.

name: sporogenous
definition: of cells or tissues, in which spores are formed.

name: sporophyll
definition: a specialized leaf bearing (on its surface or in its axil) one or more sporangia.

name: sporophyte
definition: a plant, or phase of a life cycle, that bears the spores; cf. gametophyte.

name: spreading
definition: extending horizontally, e.g. branches; standing out at right angles to axis, e.g. leaves or hairs.

name: squamule
definition: a small scale, often within the sheathing base of a leaf.

name: squamulose
definition: covered with small scales.

name: squarrose
definition: with scales, bracts, glumes etc. spreading widely from the axis.

name: stamen
definition: (adjective staminate) male organ of a flower, consisting (usually) of a stalk (filament) and a pollen-bearing portion (anther) .

name: staminode
definition: a sterile stamen, often rudimentary, but sometimes petal-like (as in some Aizoaceae).

name: standard
definition: the large posterior petal of pea-flowers.

name: stellate
definition: star-shaped, e.g. a type of hair. Figure 218aa.

name: stem-clasping
definition: see amplexicaul.

name: stigma
definition: the pollen-receptive surface of a carpel or group of fused carpels, usually sticky; usually a point or small head at the summit of the style.

name: stipe
definition: in ferns, the stalk of a frond; generally, a small stalk.

name: stipella
definition: one of two small secondary stipules at the base of leaflets in some species.

name: stipitate
definition: stalked; borne on a stipe; of an ovary, borne on a gynophore.

name: stipule
definition: small appendage at the bases of leaves in many dicotyledons.

name: stolon
definition: (adjective stoloniferous) slender, prostrate or trailing stem, producing roots and sometimes erect shoots at its nodes.

name: stoma
definition: or stomate (plural stomata or stomates) a pore; a pore in the surface of a leaf (or other aerial organ) providing access for the exchange of gases between tissues and the atmosphere.

name: stone
definition: see pyrene.

name: stone cell
definition: short sclereid cell responsible for the distinctive texture of the pear fruit; brachysclereid.

name: stramineous
definition: straw-coloured.

name: striate
definition: striped with parallel, longitudinal lines or ridges.

name: strigose
definition: with sharp, stiff, oblique to appressed hairs. Figure 219f.

name: strobilus
definition: (plural strobili) a cone-like structure consisting of sporophylls borne close together on an axis, e.g. in some club-mosses.

name: strophiole
