definition: see caruncle.

name: style
definition: an elongated part of a carpel, or group of fused carpels, between the ovary and the stigma.

name: sub-
definition: (1) somewhat or almost, e.g. submarginal = slightly inwards from the margin, subdistichous = not quite distichous; (2) under or inferior to, e.g. subgenus = a grouping between genus and species level, subspecies = a grouping within a species (usually used for geographically isolated and morphologically distinct entities).

name: subsericeous
definition: densely covered with appressed hairs but lacking a silky sheen.

name: subshrub
definition: small shrub which may have partially herbaceous stems.

name: subsp.
definition: 1 subspecies.

name: subspecies
definition: a taxonomic category, in rank between species and variety.

name: subspp.
definition: more than 1 subspecies.

name: subulate
definition: narrow and tapering gradually to a fine point. Figure 216p.

name: succulent
definition: juicy, fleshy; a plant with a fleshy habit.

name: sucker
definition: a shoot of more or less subterranean origin.

name: sulcate
definition: furrowed; grooved

name: superficial
definition: on the surface.

name: superior
definition: of an ovary, borne above the level of attachment of the other floral parts, or above the base of a floral tube (that is free from the ovary and bears the perianth and stamens); cf. inferior, half-inferior. Figure 221a.

name: suspended
definition: of an ovule, when attached slightly below the summit of the ovary; cf. pendulous.

name: sward
definition: extensive, more or less even cover of a surface, e.g. a lawn grass; cf. tussock.

name: sympatric
definition: with more or less similar or overlapping ranges of distribution.

name: syn-
definition: with, together.

name: syn.
definition: see synonym.

name: synandrium
definition: a structure formed by the cohesion of the anthers in a flower.

name: synangium
definition: a fused aggregate of sporangia.

name: synonym
definition: 1 of 2 or more names for the same taxon.

name: t.
definition: tabula, Latin for plate.

name: taproot
definition: the main, descending root of a plant with a single dominant root axis.

name: Tas.
definition: Tasmania.

name: taxon
definition: (plural taxa) a group or category in a system of classification, e.g. species.

name: tendril
definition: a slender organ (modified e.g. from stem, leaf, leaflet or stipule) used by climbing plants to cling to an object.

name: tepal
definition: perianth segment, either sepal or petal; usually used when all perianth segments are similar in appearance.

name: terete
definition: circular in cross-section; more or less cylindric. Figure 217y.

name: ternate
definition: arranged or divided into groups of 3.

name: terrestrial
definition: generally, of or on the ground; of habitat, on land as opposed to in water (aquatic) or as opposed to on rocks (lithophytic), plants (epiphytic), etc.

name: testa
definition: seed coat.

name: tetra-
definition: four.

name: tetrad
definition: a group of 4; usually, 4 pollen grains remaining fused together at maturity, e.g. in the Epacridaceae.

name: thorn
definition: a sharp, stiffened point, usually a modified stem, and not detachable without tearing the subtending tissue; a spine; cf. prickle.

name: thyrse
definition: a branched inflorescence in which the main axis is indeterminate (racemose) and the lateral branches determinate (cymose).

name: tomentum
definition: (adjective tomentose) a dense covering of short, woolly hairs. Figure 219i; hairy with hairs ascending from the surface (but not erect), 'scruffyâ€™ in appearance, e.g. in some Grevillea species.

name: toothed
definition: with a more or less regularly incised margin.

name: torus
definition: see receptacle.

name: trabeculate
definition: with transverse line or ridges, usually joining longitudinal ribs.

name: trapeziform
definition: (1) like a trapezium (a four-sided figure with two parallel sides of unequal length); (2) like a trapezoid (a four-sided figure with neither pair of sides equal); sometimes used erroneously as a synonym for rhombic.

name: tree
definition: a woody plant, usually with a single stem and more than c. 8 m high.

name: tri-
definition: three; e.g. tripinnate = with 3 pinnae, trichotomous = with 3 branches arising from the same point, trifoliate = with 3 leaflets. Figure 218o.

name: triad
definition: a group of 3.

name: triangular
definition: planar and with 3 sides.

name: tribe
definition: a taxonomic grouping, in rank between genus and family.

name: trichome
definition: in non-filamentous plants, any hair-like outgrowth from epidermis, e.g. a hair or bristle; sometimes restricted to unbranched epidermal outgrowths.

name: trigonous
definition: triangular in cross-section and obtusely angled; cf. triquetrous.

name: triquetrous
definition: more or less triangular in cross-section, but acutely angled (with 3 distinct longitudinal ridges); cf. trigonous.

name: trullate
definition: ovate, but angled; like a brick-layerâ€™s trowel; inverse kite-shaped; cf. rhombic.

name: truncate
definition: cut off squarely; with an abruptly transverse end. Figure 217g,m.

name: tuber
definition: an underground storage organ formed by the swelling of an underground stem or root which produces buds, e.g. a potato.

name: tubercle
definition: a small wart-like outgrowth. Figure 218ee.

name: tuberculate
definition: covered in tubercles; warty.

name: tunic
definition: (adjective tunicate) outer covering of some bulbs and corms.

name: turbinate
definition: top-shaped.

name: turgid
definition: swollen; firm; cf. flaccid.

name: turion
definition: (1) scaly sucker or shoot, e.g. Asparagus; (2) starch-filled perennating organ produced from rhizome of Ruppia.

name: tussock
definition: a dense tuft of vegetation, usually well separated from neighbouring tussocks, e.g. some grasses; cf. sward.

name: type
definition: an item (usually a herbarium specimen) to which the name of a taxon is permanently attached. It has importance in determining the priority of names available for a particular taxon. See also holotype.

name: umbel
definition: (adjective umbellate) a racemose inflorescence in which all the individual flower stalks arise in a cluster at the top of the peduncle and are of about equal length; in a simple umbel, each stalk is unbranched and bears only one flower; a cymose umbel is an apparent umbel but with the flowers opening centrifugally. Figure 220d.

name: umbonate
definition: with a conical projection arising from a flatter surface.

name: uncinate
definition: with a hook at the apex.

name: undershrub
definition: a low shrub, often with flowering branches that die off in winter; similar to subshrub.

name: undulate
definition: wavy and not flat; see sinuate. Figure 217t.

name: uni-
definition: one; e.g. unilateral, when on 1 side of an axis.

name: unisexual
definition: of 1 sex; bearing only male or only female reproductive organs.

name: unitubular
definition: with a single internal, longitudinal tube; e.g. the culms of some sedges, the leaves of some rushes.

name: urceolate
definition: urn-shaped.

name: utricle
definition: a small bladder; a membranous bladder-like sac enclosing an ovary or fruit; in sedges, a fruit in which the pericarp is larger than, and loosely encloses, the seed.

name: valvate
definition: of sepals and petals in bud, which meet edge to edge but do not overlap.

name: valve
definition: a portion of an organ that fragments or splits open, e.g. the teeth-like portions (of the pericarp) in a split (dehisced) capsule.

name: var.
definition: see varietas.

name: varietas
definition: (in common usage, variety) [Latin] subdivision of a species, between the categories of subspecies and form.

name: vein
definition: a strand of vascular tissue; nerve.

name: veinlet
definition: a small vein; the ultimate (visible) division of a vein.

name: velamen
definition: a water-retaining outer layer of the aerial roots of some epiphytes, e.g. some orchids.

name: velvety
definition: densely covered in fine, short, erect hairs. Figure 219g.

name: venation
definition: the arrangement of veins in a leaf.

name: ventral
definition: the front; in particular, towards axis in lateral organ or towards substratum in prostrate plant; cf. dorsal.

name: vernation
definition: the arrangement of unexpanded leaves in a bud; the order of unfolding of leaves from a bud.

name: verrucose
definition: warty.

name: versatile
definition: of anthers, swinging freely about the point of attachment to the filament.

name: verticillate
definition: arranged in one or more whorls.

name: vesicular
definition: of hairs, bladder-like; vesiculous, bearing such hairs.

name: vestigial
definition: reduced in form and function from the normal or ancestral condition.

name: Vic.
definition: Victoria.

name: villous
definition: shaggy with long, soft hairs. Figure 219p.

name: virgate
definition: slender and straight with long, flexible twigs or branches.

name: viscid
definition: sticky; coated with a thick, syrupy secretion.

name: viscidium
definition: a viscid part of the stigma (on the rostellum) in orchids.

name: vitta
definition: linear, longitudinal aromatic-oil tubes in some Apiaceae.

name: viviparous
definition: seeds or fruits which germinate before being shed from the parent plant.

name: WA
definition: Western Australia.

name: warty
definition: see tuberculate.

name: whorl
definition: a ring of organs borne at the same level on an axis, e.g. leaves, bracts, floral parts. Figure 216e.

name: wilding
definition: an escape from cultivation.

name: wing
definition: (1) a membranous expansion of a fruit or seed which aids in dispersal, e.g. on pine seeds; (2) a thin flange of tissue extending beyond the normal outline of a structure, e.g. on the column of some orchids, on stems, on petioles; (3) a lateral petal of a flower of Fabaceae.

name: woolly
definition: densely covered in long, soft, matted (usually curly) hairs. Figure 219o.

name: xeromorph
definition: a plant having structural features (e.g. hard or succulent leaves) usually associated with plants of arid habitats, but not necessarily drought-tolerant; cf. xerophyte.

name: xerophyte
definition: a drought-tolerant plant; cf. xeromorph.

name: zygomorphic
definition: bilaterally symmetric; symmetric about 1 vertical plane only; applies to flowers in which the perianth segments within each whorl vary in size and shape; cf. actinomorphic, irregular.
